mapper.insert: insert into ssm_ai_analysis_fav (chat_id, fav_sort_id, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time) values (#{chatId}, #{favSortId}, #{createdBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now())
mapper.select: select fav_id as favId, chat_id as chatId, fav_sort_id as favSortId, created_by as createdBy, date_format(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, updated_by as updatedBy, date_format(updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedTime from ssm_ai_analysis_fav where created_by = #{userName} order by fav_sort_id asc, fav_id asc
